name: code4food
description: code4food studio's Claude Code tooling: Live (skills for sessions with a human in the room), General (the skills live and factory sessions both use), Engines (godot and unity, per game repository) and seat-router (subagents on Codex and Antigravity CLIs), and fleet-room (Discord rooms for remote-control sessions, and a local room with a Codex app chat).

plugins.name: code4food-live
plugins.description: Live sessions with a human in the room: Matt Pocock's engineering and productivity skills, retargeted at the factory board (spec issue, tasks on the board, one implement path through tdd, verify, review and a PR), plus HumanLayer's show-me and visual-pr. Skills only: no injected contract, no hooks, no agents.

plugins.name: code4food-general
plugins.description: Skills that both live sessions and factory sessions use. Today one: review, which makes a working change good against the repository's own standards, its issue's acceptance criteria and its docs, and commits the fixes.

plugins.name: code4food-engines
plugins.description: Engine skills for game repositories: godot and unity, the headless invocations and the traps a session without an editor hits. A game repository enables it in its own .claude/settings.json.

plugins.name: seat-router
plugins.description: A mod that runs marked Agent calls on the Codex CLI or the Antigravity CLI (agy) instead of Claude: seat lines by size or exact model, quota-aware choice among candidates, fallback, and a band and /seats pane showing seats and each vendor's quota.

plugins.name: fleet-room
plugins.description: A Discord room for Claude sessions: trusted mentions wake the listening session; a registered tool replies as its own bot. A local room with one Codex app chat in the same project folder, and opt-in brief files that wake a session as a prompt.
